tools.name: nexhealth_list_locations
tools.description: List the practice locations for an institution (id, name, address). Good first call to discover location_ids for other tools. GET /locations.

tools.name: nexhealth_list_providers
tools.description: List practitioners (providers) for an institution, optionally scoped to a location. GET /providers.

tools.name: nexhealth_search_patients
tools.description: Search patients within a location by name, email, phone, or date of birth. Patient search is always in a location context. GET /patients.

tools.name: nexhealth_get_patient
tools.description: Fetch a single patient by id. GET /patients/{id}.

tools.name: nexhealth_list_appointments
tools.description: List appointments in a date/time window, optionally filtered by location, patient, or provider. GET /appointments.

tools.name: nexhealth_get_appointment
tools.description: Fetch a single appointment by id. GET /appointments/{id}.

tools.name: nexhealth_list_appointment_slots
tools.description: Find bookable appointment start times across providers/locations for a date range. High-value for scheduling. GET /appointment_slots.

tools.name: nexhealth_list_appointment_types
tools.description: List the appointment types configured for an institution/location. GET /appointment_types.

tools.name: nexhealth_list_operatories
tools.description: List operatories (chairs/rooms) for an institution, optionally scoped to a location. GET /operatories.

tools.name: nexhealth_list_insurance_plans
tools.description: List insurance plans known to the institution, optionally scoped to a location. GET /insurance_plans.

tools.name: nexhealth_list_insurance_coverages
tools.description: List a patient's insurance coverages. GET /insurance_coverages.

tools.name: nexhealth_list_procedures
tools.description: List clinical procedures, optionally scoped to a patient. GET /procedures.

tools.name: nexhealth_sync_status
tools.description: Report the data-sync health for the practice's EHR/PMS integration (is the Synchronizer up to date?). GET /sync_status.

tools.name: nexhealth_create_patient
tools.description: CREATE a new patient record in a location. MUTATES DATA — writes to the connected EHR/PMS. GET the patient back to confirm. POST /patients.

tools.name: nexhealth_book_appointment
tools.description: BOOK a new appointment. MUTATES DATA — creates an appointment in the connected EHR/PMS (optionally notifying the patient). Provide either end_time or appointment_type_id. POST /appointments.

tools.name: nexhealth_update_appointment
tools.description: UPDATE / reschedule / cancel / confirm an existing appointment by id. MUTATES DATA in the connected EHR/PMS. PATCH /appointments/{id}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: nexhealth_search_patients, nexhealth_create_patient · Private data: nexhealth_create_patient · Public sink: nexhealth_search_patients, nexhealth_create_patient, nexhealth_book_appointment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: nexhealth_search_patients, nexhealth_create_patient · Private data: nexhealth_create_patient · Public sink: nexhealth_search_patients, nexhealth_create_patient, nexhealth_book_appointment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
